output_list.reason: The 'transferProxy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function adds 'value' to 'balances[_to]' and 'msg.sender' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the balances of the users and gain unexpected funds.

The 'approveProxy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function adds 'value' to 'allowed[_from][_spender]' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the allowed balance of the user and gain unexpected funds.

The 'allocateTokens' function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function adds 'value' to 'totalSupply' and 'balances[_owners[i]]' without checking if the addition causes an overflow, allowing attackers to overflow the total supply and user balances and gain unexpected funds.
